purpose: Allow a second Phase 6 proof attempt on a clean committed implementation HEAD while preserving the first pre-commit attempt as historical evidence.
truth_rules: Do not rewrite or pretend the first baseline was bound to the later commit.
A new baseline must be captured only after this code is committed.
The new baseline may include historical live evidence IDs.
The implementation tracked worktree must be clean at baseline.
Verify still requires exact HEAD equality from baseline through Owner action.
